entities.summary: John Herbert Tonje is an American professional basketball player for the Boston Celtics of the National Basketball Association (NBA) on a two-way contract with the Maine Celtics of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Colorado State Rams, Missouri Tigers, and Wisconsin Badgers. Tonje was selected by the Utah Jazz in the second round of the 2025 NBA draft.
